parameters.description:
`msg-to-twilio-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Twilio destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Twilio destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Twilio destinations bound per enrollment.

In your Twilio Console (twilio.com/console), copy your Account SID as TWILIO_SMS_ACCOUNT_SID. Under Phone Numbers → Manage → Active Numbers, pick one of your Twilio numbers as TWILIO_SMS_FROM, and set the recipient's number as TWILIO_SMS_TO — both including the country calling code (e.g. +15551234567). UnitySVC sends each message as an SMS from the first number to the second through the Twilio API.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Twilio destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Twilio number
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Twilio destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

account_sid_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twilio account sid

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's TWILIO_SMS_BASIC value (same format as TWILIO_SMS_BASIC)

from_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's TWILIO_SMS_FROM value (same format as TWILIO_SMS_FROM)

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's TWILIO_SMS_TO value (same format as TWILIO_SMS_TO)
